headline: A 2005 order keeps certain federal advisory committees running and changes or cancels some earlier executive orders.
what_it_does: This order extends the life of certain advisory committees that give advice to the President and federal agencies. Without action like this, such committees can expire. The order also amends some earlier executive orders and revokes others. The title does not say which committees or orders are involved.

who_it_affects.how: The committees they serve on are allowed to keep meeting and giving advice instead of shutting down.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work with these committees
who_it_affects.how: They keep getting advice from the continued committees and must follow any changes made to earlier executive orders.
